scientific_limitations_integrity: The theorem proves a dyadic isometric reparametrization for fixed binomial columns; it does not evaluate the common law at every odd lower index or claim an odd-prime analogue. Verified finite checks corroborate but do not substitute for the general algebraic proof. title: Dyadic isometric doubling of every fixed binomial column
